programme.title: Key & Peele: MMMMMM
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan fyrer den af foran et opstemt publikum, en trafikreporter bliver udsat for turbulens i en helikopter og halvdelen af en R&B duo afslører sine sande følelser for sin partner under en optræden.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Dueling Magical Negroes
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan spiller to mystikere, der kæmper om rettigheden til at give skarpsindige råd. Andre sketches inkluderer Jaden Smith og hans agent, der diskuterer et nyt manuskript og et bøssepar, der 'fejrer' ny lovgivning.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Job Interview
programme.desc: Dommer Jessie har et nyt program, en mand venter på sit jobinterview, to damer sludrer, parkeringsvagter diskuterer Val Kilmer, en pensioneret mand fra hæren hører om et nyt projekt og en kvinde introducerer sin forlovede for sine forældre.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Terrible Henchman
programme.desc: En nødsituation tvinger en mand til at ændre sit morgen, en håndlanger ødelægger det for superskurken og Jordan minder Keegan om, at han er voksen nu.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Country Music
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Steve Jobs' efterfølger, Ice-T som en uartig hvalp og Rihanna og Chris Brown prøver igen.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sexy Vampires
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en uhyggelig asiatisk spøgelsesbofælle, fyrene ser på den lyse side af tortur og Keegan oplever et hus fyldt med sexede vampyrer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Hollywood Sequel Doctor
programme.desc: En kildeleg mellem to venner bliver mærkelig, forfattere brainstormer til 'Gremlins 2', to bøller mistænker deres ven for at stjæle og Keegan og Jorden diskuterer Afrika til en fest.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Detective
programme.desc: En respekteret kriminalbetjent, ekspert i sexforbrydelser, bruger ukonventionelle metoder for at løse en sag, en actionhelt redder sin kæreste og en ansat i en forretning med yoghurtis tester for mange vareprøver.

programme.title: Key & Peele: MC Mom
programme.desc: En gangster deltager i et skuddrama, en mor skriver en sang til sin søn, to bondefangere konkurrerer, Big Boi møder André 3000 og to fyre kommer ud for et biluheld.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bitch
programme.desc: I denne seriepremiere af komedieprogrammet prøver Jordan Peele og Keegan Michael Key at sige et forbudt ord om deres kvinder, Lil Wayne vænner sig til livet bag tremmer og præsident Obama udtrykker, hvad han virkelig føler.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Manly Tears
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en narkohandel, der går galt, en mafiafyr, der er en stor tudemarie, og Darius Rucker, der prøver at håndterer sin Hootie-fortid.

programme.title: Broad City: Rat Pack
programme.desc: Efter at have modtaget en stor regning for skadedyrsbekæmpelse holder Jaime og Ilana en fest for at dække omkostningerne. I mellemtiden har Abbi en mission om at møde nye mennesker.

programme.title: Broad City: 2016
programme.desc: Ilana finder sit nye kald, og Abbi tage forbi det mest frygtede sted i verden: motorkontoret.

programme.title: Broad City: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana drar til Philly for at besøge Abbis barndomshjem . Da Abbi indser, at hun begik en stor fejl i high school, tager hun og Ilana ud på en forsoningsmission.

programme.title: Broad City: B&B-NYC
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana lægger deres lejligheder ud på B & B-NYC for at tjene lidt ekstra penge.

programme.title: Broad City: Burning Bridges
programme.desc: Ilanas forældre kommer til byen til deres 30-års jubilæum, men Abbi og Ilana synes, det er svært at fejre, når de begge har samlivsproblemer.

programme.title: Broad City: Getting There
programme.desc: Abbi og Ilana skal ud at rejse, men det er sværere at komme i lufhavnen end forventet.

programme.title: Broad City: Jews on a Plane
programme.desc: Abbi får menses under en flytur, så hun og Ilana går drastisk til værks for at finde en tampon.

programme.title: Broad City: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: På en forårsdag i 2011 mødes Abbi og Ilana for første gang.

programme.title: Broad City: Twaining Day
programme.desc: Abbi vender tilbage til Soulstice, og det bliver interessant, da hun bliver tilbudt den træning, hun altid har drømt om. Ilana får et nyt job på en restaurant.

programme.title: Broad City: Just the Tips
programme.desc: Iliana shopper vildt med sine drikkepenge fra servitricejobbet, og Abbi stråler i sit nye forhold. Senere den aften støder pigerne ind i en gammel ven til en fest.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Anniversary
programme.desc: The guys hit a strip club to celebrate Garcia's 15-year anniversary on the force.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Burning Man Festival
programme.desc: When the Sheriff's Department receives $1200 to get people off the streets, Garcia helps a hooker, and Dangle heads to Burning Man.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Moving Day
programme.desc: Dangle needs help moving out of his house, and Junior teaches Reno's youth about prison life.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Terrorist Training Pt. 1
programme.desc: The Office of Homeland Security teaches the Reno Sheriff's Department terrorist attack protocol, and Clemmy's mom gets into trouble.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Terrorist Training Pt. 2
programme.desc: The Reno Sherriff's Department passes their Homeland Security exam with flying colors, and Clemmy and a drunk driver discover some new moves.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Halloween
programme.desc: On Halloween, the deputies prepare for a night of mayhem, and Wiegel sets a sting operation to catch mischievous teens.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Promotion
programme.desc: Dangle gets a new job in Carson City, but the deputies are too wrapped up in women's basketball to give him a proper send-off.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: Wiegel's new boyfriend, Craig, bears an uncanny resemblance to the Truckee River Serial Killer.

programme.title: RENO 911!: British Law
programme.desc: Inspector Martin Smiley of the U.K. joins the Reno Sheriff's Department in an exchange program.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Wife Visits
programme.desc: Divorce looms over Dangle and his estranged wife, and the rest of the department struggles with a giant Ten Commandments monument.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: I Know Black People & Keeping It Real Goes Wrong
programme.desc: Dave asks contestants how much they know about black American culture.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Oprah's Baby Daddy & Jury Duty
programme.desc: Dave gets Oprah pregnant and recalls being a member of the O.J. Simpson trial jury.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Kneehigh Park & Making da Band
programme.desc: P. Diddy gives unusual requests, and Snoop Dogg visits Kneehigh Park; appearances by Q-Tip and Wyclef Jean.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Mandela Boot Camp & The Time Haters

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: PopCopy & Clayton Bigsby

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Tyrone Biggums at School & Wrap It Up Box
programme.desc: Crack addict Tyrone Biggums visits an elementary school.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Zapped & It's a Wonderful Chest

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Reparations & NY Boobs
programme.desc: Great New York boobs get awards, and Dave predicts reparations chaos.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Great Moments in Hookup History & Ask a Black Dude
programme.desc: With time running out, Martin Johnson has one last stab at glory: Ashley "Smashly" Evans.

programme.title: Tosh.0: "Smell Yo D**k" Girl
programme.desc: I sommerpremieren afslører vores leder Daniel sin sommerkollektion og pigen, der sang 'Smell Yo Dick' får genoprejsning.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Skateboarding Fail
programme.desc: Daniel får en konto på Kickstarter og ser, hvad folk søger efter på Google. Og en skater, som kunne være død, får genoprejsning.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Pepper Spray Neutralizer
programme.desc: Daniel bliver skudt af en kanon, finder på sine egne emoticons og giver genoprejsning til fyren, der blev oversprøjtet med peberspray.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Spelling Bee Kid
programme.desc: Daniel giver genoprejsning til fyren fra stavekonkurrencen, taler med zombier og sprænger noget.

programme.title: Tosh.0: How to Flirt Guy
programme.desc: Daniel tilbyder gratis lægeråd og genoprejsningen handler om, hvordan man scorer piger.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Bubb Rubb
programme.desc: Daniel giver folk fem dollar for at de skal more sig over at kvaje sig, opfinder et nyt spil, som skal ersatte 'F, Marry, Kill' og giver genoprejsning til Bubb Rubb.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Kid Juggalo
programme.desc: Daniel finder på nye udfordringer på Internettet, belønner jer, hvis I chikanerer jeres venner med 'Slap, Lick, Fondle'-videoer og giver genoprejsning til en 14-årig Juggalo.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Army Prankster
programme.desc: Daniel tager blusen af, og fyren, der lavede sjov med sin mor, går ind i hæren og får genoprejsning.

programme.title: Tosh.0: S**tty Rock Climber
programme.desc: Daniel går langt for sine kvindelige fans og en bjergbestiger får genoprejsning.

programme.title: Tosh.0: Hurl-a-Whirl
programme.desc: Daniel koger to ugers OL-optagelser ned til mindre end et minut og viser det mest kvalmende indslag nogensinde.

programme.title: Jeff Ross: Roasts The Border
programme.desc: I dette program, der er delvis stand-up og delvis dokumenter, gransker og dissekerer Jeff Ross USA'simmigrationsdebat.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle I: Live Finals
programme.desc: Et fire timer langt program hvor roastmesteren Jeff Ross er vært. 16 komikere dyster, men kun en kan vinde dette Roast Battle. I aftenens live finale er gæstedommerne Sarah Silverman og Judd Apatow.

programme.title: The Roast of William Shatner
programme.desc: The Roast of William Shatner blev nomineret til en Primetime Emmy Award i 2007. Afsnittet placerer skuespilleren William Shatner i den varme stol, mens Roastmasteren Jason Alexander og en bred vifte af komikere får ham ned med nakken.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle II
programme.desc: Jeff Ross tager på turné som vært for Roast Battle i amerikanske byer. Der er kendte gæstedommere, deltagerne går på scenen og prøver at overgå hinanden i grovheder for at vinde mesterskabsbæltet.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Roasts Cops
programme.desc: Roastmester general Jeff Ross taler med Black Lives Matter-aktivister, kører en øjenåbnende tur med politiet og roaster folk fra Boston Politi.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen

programme.title: Bense på tur: Oliver Bjerrehuus

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery DA: Kiruna

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skeleton Key
programme.desc: In 2004, nursing student Tamika Huston went missing from her Spartanburg, South Carolina home. A tip led detectives to her car, where they found an unknown house key that could help solve the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Funeral Services
programme.desc: In 2002, funeral director Lonnie Turner, Sr. was found shot to death. His son Lonnie Jr. became the prime suspect, particularly after it was discovered that the murder was committed with his gun. However, he had an alibi for the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Expert Witness
programme.desc: In 1993, young mother Tammy Tatum was sexually assaulted and murdered in her Longmont, Colorado apartment. Police initially suspected her estranged husband, but did not have enough evidence to charge him and the case went cold.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gravity

programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.desc: To the Moon - The Apollo program achieves its major objective. Dragon, Falcon and Spacex - New directions in re-usable spacecraft. Gaia- Mapping our galaxy in unprecedented detail.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury Advancement, Camera Tracking & The International Space Station
programme.desc: Project Mercury Advances - America's first manned space program finally puts a man in orbit. Camera Tracking - The array of special cameras that follow a spacecraft at launch. The International Space Station - The building and operation.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly får britisk besøg

programme.title: iCarly: iPære-butikken
